records.name: Policy & Advocacy
records.notes: Campaigns include Asilomar Principles (5,700+ signatories), 2023 Pause Letter (33,000+ signatories), AI Act advocacy. EU and UN engagement. Led by Mark Brakel (Global Director of Policy).

records.name: FLI Grants Program
records.notes: FLI's grantmaking arm. $25M+ distributed since 2015 across AI safety, nuclear risk, governance, and existential risk reduction. Andrea Berman is Grants Manager.

records.name: Fellowship Programs
records.notes: Vitalik Buterin PhD and Postdoctoral Fellowships in AI Existential Safety. Run with BAIF. 14+ PhD fellows and 4+ postdocs at top universities. Falls under Operations & Grants team.
